remarks: Wonderful opportunity to restore this iconic Antique property back to it's original stately beauty! Offering over 4,000 square feet across 3 floors, this impressive home is currently a commercial property and features 6 treatment rooms easily convertible back into bedrooms. Several of the 4 half-baths are generously sized and offer the potential to be transformed into full baths. Classic architectural details abound, including high ceilings, hardwood floors, a fireplace, pocket doors, and a charming wraparound front porch- perfect for enjoying the home's historic character. Outside, the property includes a carriage barn with two stalls, originally designed for horses, adding to the estate's unique appeal. Located in the historic Cannondale area of Wilton, this truly special property offers endless potential for restoration and customization. Come take a look and imagine the possibilities! Also for sale as a Commercial Property MLS#24061453
